notes: LoRaWAN does not mandate OTP/fuse as a protocol concept, but the root identity (DevEUI, JoinEUI, AppKey for OTAA; or DevAddr/NwkSKey/AppSKey for ABP) is device-unique secret material typically stored in secure/non-volatile memory at manufacture. An implementation may back these with fuses or a secure element.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Globally unique IEEE EUI-64 device identifier, provisioned at manufacture.
AES-128 root key for OTAA session-key derivation; device-unique secret.
